title: Carlsbad City Council Meeting #1: Public Comment: August 23, 2016

segments.text: um good evening mayor Hall City Council
Members my name is Donna Bower I reside
at 4260 Skyline Road in Carlsbad in
March of this year I hosted a party
celebrating the no on measure a
victory councilman Keith Blackburn chose
that day to Dawn his uniform and be a
policeman he is allowed to do this one
day a month on a special exemption
passed for him by the council ordinarily
it would be a conflict of interest to
serve part-time on the police force
while serving on the city council on
that day in March he used his powers as
a policeman to run the plates on my
guest Vehicles though they were legally
parked I requested an investigation into
this misuse of police
Authority at the end of May the police
chief sent a letter to me that ended up
in the hands of a neighbor as the letter
was incorrectly posted I given your
clerk a copy of the letters so somebody
else received that letter opened it and
then delivered it to my
home the letter stated that quote your
complaint has been resolved in the event
that our investigator determined that
during that course of that incident that
officers actions were not proper or
within Department policy appropriate
disciplinary action will be taken in the
event that that officer's actions were
proper and within but departmental
policy no disciplinary action will be
taken please understand that California
law requires confidentiality in all
matters of all officer discipline
unquote here we have a prime example as
to why standard practice is not allowed
an elected councilman to both have an
elected official and be a police officer
how can the police department dependent
as it is on the council for its budget
to be expected to discipline a council
member for his conduct as an officer
this is serious ethical issue that
should no longer be tolerated I Call On
You Mr Blackburn to release the report
on this incident to the public Mr
Blackburn it is within your power to do
so further it is your responsibility to
protect the Integrity of both the city
council and of the police department
this can be done by request from you to
this special Arrangement additionally I
am asking at least two members of this
city council to place this issue on the
council's agenda at a meeting prior to
the November election so the council can
consider whether the Blackburn exception
to the conflict of interest policy
should be rescinded thank you
